title: Payment for environmental services in Brazil: A systematic scoping review of policy design, governance, and territorial patterns
title_zh: 巴西环境服务付费：政策设计、治理与地域格局的系统性范围综述
authors: Manoel Martins da Costa Junior, Vanessa Batista Schramm, Fernando Schramm
abstract: Brazil established its National Policy of Payment for Environmental Services (PES) to promote the maintenance, recovery, and enhancement of ecosystems. Yet the diversity, spatial distribution, and effectiveness of existing initiatives remain poorly understood. This study provides the first nationwide synthesis of all PES programs implemented in Brazil since 2000, based on a systematic scoping review of 80 peer-reviewed papers documenting 138 distinct programs. We apply an analytical framework with 11 dimensions to classify and compare programs by ecosystem type, service category, funding source, objectives, and governance mechanisms. Results show initiatives concentrate in the Atlantic Forest (49.3%) and Cerrado (23.2%) biomes, largely targeting regulation services (93.2%) via forest conservation (65.2%) and restoration (61.6%) actions. Watershed (73.9%) and Forest & Carbon (14.8%) programs predominate; 59.4% of initiatives are in Southeast and 17.4% in North. Most programs rely on public funding (94%), while private and market-based mechanisms remain rare. Despite frequent social objectives (65%) and non-monetary benefits (35%), fiscal dependence and regional imbalance constrain scalability and policy sustainability. By comparing Brazil’s experience with international trends in PES governance, we identify structural challenges to design more adaptive, inclusive, and financially diversified mechanisms that strengthen ecosystem protection and social equity across biomes. Explicitly contrasting Brazil with Latin – American benchmarks, we show that – unlike Costa Rica’s centralized national PES and Mexico’s federally coordinated watershed schemes – Brazil’s policy has fostered a decentralized mosaic of municipal and state programs, closely linked to Forest Code compliance and frequent mixed (cash and in-kind) payments, outlining a distinct regional governance model.
abstract_zh: 巴西建立了国家生态系统服务付费政策，旨在促进生态系统的维护、恢复与增强。然而，现有举措的多样性、空间分布及有效性仍缺乏充分认知。本研究基于对80篇同行评审论文的系统性范围综述（涵盖138个独立项目），首次对2000年以来巴西实施的所有生态系统服务付费项目进行全国性综合梳理。我们运用包含11个维度的分析框架，从生态系统类型、服务类别、资金来源、目标及治理机制等方面对项目进行分类比较。结果显示：项目集中于大西洋森林（49.3%）和塞拉多（23.2%）生物群落，主要通过森林保护（65.2%）和恢复（61.6%）行动瞄准调节服务（93.2%）；流域项目（73.9%）与森林碳汇项目（14.8%）占主导地位；59.4%的举措分布在东南部，17.4%在北部。多数项目依赖公共资金（94%），私营和市场机制仍属罕见。尽管频繁设定社会目标（65%）并提供非货币收益（35%），财政依赖性与区域失衡制约了可扩展性与政策可持续性。通过将巴西经验与国际生态系统服务付费治理趋势对比，我们识别出设计更具适应性、包容性和财务多元化机制的结构性挑战，以强化跨生物群落的生态保护与社会公平。与拉美基准国家的明确对比表明：不同于哥斯达黎加的中央集权式国家生态系统服务付费和墨西哥的联邦协调流域计划，巴西政策催生了分散化的市州级项目拼图，这些项目与《森林法》合规要求紧密关联，并频繁采用混合支付（现金与实物）模式，勾勒出独特的区域治理范式。

title: The Productivity Effect of High Involvement Management: Causal Evidence From Germany
title_zh: 高参与管理的生产率效应：来自德国的因果证据
abstract: This study empirically examines the effects of High Involvement Management ( HIM ) on establishment productivity. To achieve this it draws on a large‐scale panel data set representative of the German economy. The identification strategy exploits the bracketing property of fixed effects and lagged dependent variable models and supplements this with a selection‐on‐observables approach to estimate causal effects. Descriptive evidence indicates that decision makers value the joint implementation of the pillars of HIM ( Knowledge , Power , Information , and Rewards ), as they tend to cluster and factor analysis confirms that the included management practices reflect a single underlying management orientation. The causal analysis reveals significant productivity gains from HIM and each of its four pillars. These effects materialize for HIM adoption, HIM intensification and the presence of a HIM philosophy. While the results are in line with a monotonically increasing effect as additional pillars are adopted, no synergies between the pillars or underlying practices emerge. Finally, the findings reveal no meaningful differences in the effectiveness of HIM across establishment size, sector, knowledge intensity, or innovation strategy, suggesting that its impact is broadly consistent across organizational contexts.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究实证检验了高参与管理（HIM）对企业生产率的影响。为此，我们使用了代表德国经济的大规模面板数据集。识别策略利用了固定效应和滞后因变量模型的边界特性，并辅以基于可观测变量的选择方法以估计因果效应。描述性证据表明，决策者重视HIM四大支柱（知识、权力、信息与奖励）的联合实施，因为这些支柱往往呈现聚类特征，且因子分析证实所包含的管理实践反映了一种单一的基础管理导向。因果分析显示，HIM及其四大支柱均能带来显著的生产率提升。这些效应体现在HIM的采纳、强化以及HIM理念的存在上。尽管结果与采纳更多支柱时效应单调递增的规律一致，但各支柱或基础实践之间并未显现协同效应。最后，研究发现HIM的有效性在企业规模、行业、知识密集度或创新战略方面不存在显著差异，表明其影响在不同组织情境中具有广泛一致性。

title: A Welfare Analysis of Policies Impacting Climate Change
title_zh: 气候变化政策的福利分析
authors: Robert W. Hahn, Nathaniel Hendren, Robert D. Metcalfe, Ben Sprung-Keyser
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the welfare impacts of 96 climate-related tax and spending policies. We extend and apply the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) framework, most notably providing a new method for incorporating learning-by-doing spillovers. We find subsidies for the production of clean energy (such as wind production tax credits) have higher MVPFs than all other subsidies in our sample, including EV subsidies. Conservation nudges have large MVPFs when targeting regions with dirty grids. Fuel taxes and cap-and-trade policies are highly efficient means of raising revenue. We also construct traditional cost-per-ton estimates and compare and contrast the lessons they provide. (JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了96项与气候相关的税收和支出政策的福利影响。我们对公共资金边际价值（MVPF）框架进行了扩展和应用，尤其提出了一种纳入干中学溢出效应的新方法。研究发现，清洁能源生产补贴（如风电生产税收抵免）的MVPF高于样本中所有其他补贴，包括电动汽车补贴。针对电网污染严重地区的节能引导政策具有较高的MVPF。燃油税和总量控制与交易政策是高效的财政收入手段。我们还构建了传统的每吨成本估算，并比较了这些估算所提供的政策启示。（JEL分类号：D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58）

title: Paying £1(£5) or nothing in dictator games: unexpected differences
title_zh: 独裁者游戏中支付1英镑（5英镑）与零支付的意外差异
authors: Pablo Brañas-Garza, Antonio M. Espín, Diego Jorrat
abstract: We conducted an online Dictator Game experiment ( N = 1195) to test three hypotheses about the role of monetary incentives in prosocial behavior. First, we examined whether real incentives of £1 reduce the dispersion of responses compared to hypothetical ones. Surprisingly, we found the opposite: hypothetical responses were less dispersed, with choices clustering around the egalitarian split. This pattern held in a replication ( N = 308) with higher stakes (£5), offering no support for the first hypothesis. Second, we tested whether real incentives—by involving actual monetary consequences—lead to more selfish decisions, as they are expected to reduce socially desirable responses. With £1 stakes, no significant differences emerged across conditions. However, when the stake was increased to £5, participants became more selfish under real incentives, supporting the second hypothesis only when the amount at stake is substantial. Third, we explored whether probabilistic payments trigger differential behavior. At low stakes, probabilistic incentives resembled real ones. But with higher stakes, real and probabilistic outcomes diverged, suggesting participants respond to expected value only when it is meaningful. Finally, in a separate study ( N = 299), we found that many participants facing standard hypothetical-payment instructions still expected real payments. Only explicit phrasing stating that “unfortunately, the money is not real” alleviated this confusion. This result underscores the importance of precise wording in experimental design and potentially explains why hypothetical treatments do not yield dramatically different results compared to real-money treatments.
abstract_zh: 我们开展了一项在线独裁者博弈实验（样本量N=1195），以检验关于货币激励在亲社会行为中作用的三个假设。首先，我们考察了与假设性激励相比，1英镑的真实激励是否会降低反应离散度。令人意外的是，我们发现了相反的结果：假设性情境下的反应离散度更低，选择集中在平等主义分配方案附近。这一模式在更高赌注（5英镑）的重复实验（样本量N=308）中得以保持，因此第一个假设未获支持。其次，我们检验了真实激励——通过涉及实际货币后果——是否会导致更自私的决策，因为预期这会减少社会期望性反应。在1英镑赌注下，各条件之间未出现显著差异。然而，当赌注增至5英镑时，参与者在真实激励下变得更加自私，这仅在赌注金额较大时支持了第二个假设。第三，我们探讨了概率性支付是否会引发差异化行为。在低赌注下，概率性激励与真实激励相似。但在高赌注下，真实与概率性结果出现分化，表明参与者仅在有意义的预期价值下才会做出反应。最后，在另一项独立研究（样本量N=299）中，我们发现许多面对标准假设性支付说明的参与者仍预期会获得真实支付。只有明确表述“遗憾的是，这笔钱并非真实”才能缓解这种混淆。这一结果凸显了实验设计中措辞精确的重要性，并可能解释为何假设性处理与真实货币处理相比不会产生显著不同的结果。

title: On the development strategy of countries of intermediate size - An analysis of heterogenous firms in a multiregion framework
title_zh: 中等规模国家发展战略研究——基于多区域框架下的异质性企业分析
official: 官方在线 2011-01-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper compares two policies: trade cost reduction and firm relocation cost reduction using a three-country version of a heterogeneous-firms economic geography model, where the three countries have different market (population) size. We show how the effects of the two policies differ, in particular, for the country of intermediate size. Unless the intermediate country is very small, it will gain industry when relocation costs are reduced, but lose industry when trade costs are reduced. The smallest country loses industry in both cases, but only experiences lower welfare in the case of lower relocation costs. Thus, the ranking of the policies from the point of view of the two small and intermediate countries tends to be the opposite.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含三个国家的异质性企业经济地理模型，比较了贸易成本降低与企业迁移成本降低两种政策的效果。其中，三个国家具有不同的市场规模（人口规模）。我们揭示了这两种政策效应的差异，尤其聚焦于中等规模国家。除非中等规模国家非常小，否则当迁移成本降低时，该国将获得产业增长；而当贸易成本降低时，该国将面临产业流失。最小规模国家在两种情形下均会失去产业，但仅在迁移成本降低时遭遇福利下降。因此，从两个小国和中等规模国家的视角来看，两种政策的优劣排序往往呈现相反趋势。

title: Stochastic Optimization and Worst Case Analysis in Monetary Policy Design
title_zh: DP5019 货币政策设计中的随机优化与最坏情况分析
authors: Berc Rustem, Volker Wieland, Stan Zakovic
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this paper we compare expected loss minimization to worst-case or minimax analysis in the design of simple Taylor-style rules for monetary policy using a small model estimated for the euro area by Orphanides and Wieland (2000). We find that rules optimized under a minimax objective in the presence of general parameter and shock uncertainty do not imply extreme policy activism. Such rules tend to obey the Brainard principle of cautionary policy-making in much the same way as rules derived by expected loss minimization. Rules derived by means of minimax analysis are effective insurance policies limiting maximum loss over ranges of parameter values to be set by the policy-maker. In practice, we propose to set these ranges with an eye towards the cost of such insurance cover in terms of the implied increase in expected inflation variability.
abstract_zh: 本文通过奥法尼德斯和维兰德（2000）估算的欧元区小型模型，比较了简单泰勒规则货币政策设计中预期损失最小化与最坏情况（即极小化极大分析）两种方法。研究发现，在存在一般参数和冲击不确定性的情况下，基于极小化极大目标优化的规则并不会导致极端的政策激进性。这类规则倾向于遵循布雷纳德审慎决策原则，其方式与通过预期损失最小化推导的规则高度相似。通过极小化极大分析推导的规则是有效的保险策略，能够将政策制定者设定的参数区间内的最大损失限制在可控范围内。在实践中，我们建议根据此类保险覆盖的成本（以隐含的预期通胀波动性增加来衡量）来设定这些参数区间。
